name: redirected-git-push-to-main-still-asks-for-picto
note: Gate-evasion regression (field report): appending `2>&1` made the mapper capture the refspec as `git.push:refs/heads/2>&1`, which did not match gate-main-push, so the push slipped through. strip_redirections in the per-segment candidate now yields the real `git.push:refs/heads/main`, and the main-push gate fires as it does for the bare command.
